$comment: Duplication budget for the maintained source tree.
The measured baseline at the time this was written is 1.61% of TypeScript
lines and 1.49% of tokens, so the 3% floor has real headroom and will catch
newly introduced copy-paste without blocking ordinary work. Whole-repo
duplication reads 30% only because it counts YAML, Markdown and lockfiles,
which is not what a duplication budget is for — so this is scoped to source.
Tests are excluded: two table-driven suites that assert the same rule from
opposite directions is a feature, not a clone. Generated files are excluded
because they are not maintained by hand.
